verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Teams Export APIs, which export 1:1, group, meeting and channel messages. The docs also say messages users delete from the Teams client stay reachable through those APIs for 21 days, which implies user deletion exists and states a fixed post-deletion retention window. Nothing shows users or admins setting retention periods or controlling permanent deletion. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, admin or user controls for permanent deletion or purge, retention controls for Copilot or agent data, independent corroboration.
